dogecoin.text: There are now so many crypto currencies that take-up will continue to dilute to the point that all interest in what was completely sentiment-driven will disappear. Very fickle when a tweet from Elon Musk influences price. Goodbye crypto. Hi Gold, my old friend. #Bitcoin #Dogecoin
@elonmusk Is there any connection between you promoting Dogecoin and setting up a department [D.O.G.E] with a similar name?
